result.topic_en: An expression for the variation δ1 of a sum over a polygon/triangulation with vertices labelled a…v, written as a sum of differences of complex vertex labels times sums of cotangents of angles multiplied by variations δa, δab, etc., followed by a lemma on a triangle's complex vertices and angles.
result.transcription:
$\delta 1 = -(1-21)(\cot a^1 + \cot a^2)\delta a + (1-21)(\cot a^2 + \cot b^2)\delta ab -$
$-(1-21)(\cot b^2 + \cot b^3)\delta b + (1-4)(\cot b^3 - \cot c^{21})\delta bc + (4-21)(\cot b^3 + \cot c^3)\delta bc$
$+(1-3)(\cot c^{21} + \cot c^4)\delta c - (1-5)(\cot c^4 - \cot d^3)\delta cd - (5-3)(\cot c^4 + \cot d^4)\delta cd$
$-(1-4)(\cot d^3 + \cot d^5)\delta d + (1-6)(\cot d^5 - \cot e^4)\delta de + (6-4)(\cot d^5 + \cot e^5)\delta de$
$+(1-5)(\cot e^4 + \cot e^6)\delta e - (1-6)(\cot e^6 - \cot f^5)\delta ef - (6-4)(\cot e^5 + \cot e^6)\delta ef$
$-(1-6)(\cot f^5 + \cot f^7)\delta f + (1-6)(\cot f^7 + \cot g^7)\delta fg$
$-(1-6)(\cot g^7 + \cot g^8)\delta g + (1-6)(\cot g^8 + \cot h^8)\delta gh$
$-(1-6)(\cot h^8 + \cot h^9)\delta h + (1-10)(\cot h^9 - \cot i^6)\delta hi + (10-6)(\cot h^9 + \cot i^9)\delta hi$
$+(1-9)(\cot i^6 + \cot i^{10})\delta i - (1-10)(\cot i^{10} - \cot k^9)\delta ik - (10-6)(\cot i^9 + \cot i^{10})\delta ik$
$-(1-10)(\cot k^9 + \cot k^{11})\delta k + (1-12)(\cot k^{11} - \cot l^{10}) d kl + (12-10)(\cot k^{11} + \cot l^{11})\delta kl$
$+(1-11)(\cot l^{10} + \cot l^{12})\delta l - (1-12)(\cot l^{12} - \cot m^{11}) d lm - (12-10)(\cot l^{11} + \cot l^{12})\delta lm$
$-(1-12)(\cot m^{11} + \cot m^{13})\delta m + (1-12)(\cot m^{13} + \cot n^{13})\delta mn$
$-(1-12)(\cot n^{13} + \cot n^{14})\delta n + (1-12)(\cot n^{14} + \cot o^{14})\delta no$
$-(1-12)(\cot o^{14} + \cot o^{15})\delta o + (1-16)(\cot o^{15} - \cot p^{12})\delta op + (16-12)(\cot o^{15} + \cot p^{15})\delta op$
$+(1-15)(\cot p^{12} + \cot p^{16})\delta p - (1-16)(\cot p^{16} - \cot q^{15})\delta pq - (16-12)(\cot p^{15} + \cot p^{16})\delta pq$
$-(1-16)(\cot q^{15} + \cot q^{17})\delta q + (1-16)(\cot q^{17} + \cot r^{17})\delta qr$
$-(1-16)(\cot r^{17} + \cot r^{18})\delta r + (1-19)(\cot r^{18} - \cot s^{16})\delta rs + (19-16)(\cot r^{18} + \cot s^{18})\delta rs$
$+(1-18)(\cot s^{16} + \cot s^{19})\delta s - (1-19)(\cot s^{19} - \cot t^{18})\delta st - (19-16)(\cot s^{18} + \cot s^{19})\delta st$
$-(1-19)(\cot t^{18} + \cot t^{20})\delta t + (1-21)(\cot t^{20} - \cot u^{19})\delta tu + (21-19)(\cot t^{20} + \cot u^{20})\delta tu$
$+(1-20)(\cot u^{19} + \cot u^{21})\delta u - (1-21)(\cot u^{21} - \cot v^{20})\delta uv - (21-19)(\cot u^{20} + \cot u^{21})\delta uv$
$-(1-21)(\cot v^{20} + \cot v^1)\delta v + (1-21)(\cot v^1 + \cot a^1)\delta va$

methods.what: Expansion of the variation δ1 as a linear combination of variations δa, δab, … with coefficients given by differences of complex vertex values times sums/differences of cotangents of angles
methods.quote: $\delta 1 = -(1-21)(\cot a^1 + \cot a^2)\delta a + (1-21)(\cot a^2 + \cot b^2)\delta ab -$

methods.what: Lemma: for a triangle with complex vertices α, β, γ (positively oriented) and angles A, B, C, the side vectors satisfy a cotangent identity
Cyclic companion of the triangle cotangent lemma

items.quote:
Lemma wenn $\alpha, \beta, \gamma$ die complexen Zahlen sind, die die drei Ecken eines $\Delta$ bezeichnen in der Ordnung der tägl. B.[?]; $A, B, C$ die Winkel; so ist
$(\alpha-\beta)\cot C + (\alpha-\gamma)\cot B = (\gamma-\beta)i$
items.english: Lemma: if α, β, γ are the complex numbers that denote the three vertices of a triangle in the order of the daily motion[?], and A, B, C the angles, then (α−β)cot C + (α−γ)cot B = (γ−β)i.
